name: OmaLvL
author: Tiedeyez
description: Level up by using your Omarchy machine: 17 skills in six areas, a Rice rating hexagon, theme seasons and stamps, dotfile relics, a keybind tree, quests that teach Omarchy and Linux, daily contracts and a pixel wallpaper of your stats. Pixel art in your theme's colours; activity data stays local.
